_comment: Hunch (pattern-deduction 'Signal/Green Light') screenshot capture. 60-level CAMPAIGN (valid loadLevel indices 0-59, display = idx+1). A fresh Hunch level renders an EMPTY 4x4 lab grid, so window._hunchFill(cells) lights a distinct pattern + runs doTest() twice to populate the verdict + experiment history (matches real mid-solve play and makes every slot visually distinct). Themes applied via window._applyAT(id,midnight) -> PIPE_COLORS + --go/--no/--lit CSS vars + midnight body chrome. Non-gameplay screens once: Themes panel -> phone 06. Phone ships 7, tablets ship 2 each.
